approach: Static recompilation of the game into native C, plus a runtime that reproduces the hardware, so no interpreter sits in the hot path.
help: Reverse engineering the room and object system
notes: Public builds for Linux x86_64 since v0.1, toolchain only: you supply your own copy of the game and no game data is distributed. Frame-exact against a cycle-accurate reference; 75 of 75 Blargg and Mooneye tests pass. The goal is a true widescreen remaster: a 256px surface out of the guest's own framebuffer, the room's real scene on both sides instead of bars, the guest's own soldiers alive in the extended area, mastered audio, a presentation shader. The authentic 160px build stays for purists. Next: margin fidelity, audio, then the shader. Windows and Android are planned, not built.
